result.title: LyapuFlow: Controlling Generative Flows with Lyapunov Feedback for Inverse Problems
result.summary: Pretrained flow models are now widely used as generative priors in science and vision, where inference-time guidance enables test-time constraints without retraining. Existing methods use projection, posterior sampling, or iterative optimization of the generative trajectory. We propose LyapuFlow, an alternative based on Lyapunov feedback control. At each sampling step, LyapuFlow predicts the terminal sample towards which the current flow is evolving, and evaluates the constraint violation on this prediction. Then, we compute the minimum-norm control that satisfies a prescribed Lyapunov decrease condition. The resulting control remains inactive when the uncontrolled dynamics already reduce the constraint violation at the prescribed rate. Otherwise, it provides a corrective update within a feedback trust region that prevents the control from dominating the pretrained dynamics. We demonstrate LyapuFlow in both data and latent spaces, outperforming alternatives spanning different mechanisms for test-time constraint enforcement in scientific machine learning and image inverse problems.

AI.brief_summary: LyapuFlow 提出用 Lyapunov 反馈控制代替投影或后验采样，在生成流的每个采样步预测终态样本、评估约束违反程度，并求最小范数控制量，使约束违反按指定速率下降；在数据空间与 latent 空间演示了科学机器学习和图像逆问题上的测试时约束满足。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按 Lyapunov 递减条件决定「何时施加控制、幅度多大」的机制，可能为 LVR 中「何时干预/停止」及 latent 状态约束筛选提供可核查的借鉴；但该工作面向生成式逆问题求解，未涉及视觉推理的 latent 状态使用与答案生成，联系需较多核查。
